efficacy_outcome: ALT decreased with pioglitazone (MD −38.41, p<0.001), SGLT2 inhibitors (−16.17, p<0.001), GLP-1 agonists (−27.98, p=0.04), and DPP-4 inhibitors (−7.41, p<0.001). Steatosis improved significantly with pioglitazone (SMD −1.01, p<0.001) and GLP-1 agonists (−2.53, p=0.03), but not significantly with SGLT2 inhibitors or DPP-4 inhibitors (p=0.06 for each).
